text:
support_julie: FYI — customer AcmeInsights opened a high-severity ticket: embeddings endpoint returning 1536-dim vectors after we pinned their model to a reserved variant. They expected 1024 and their index ingestion crashed.

acme_bryan: Confirmed on our side. Received embeddings payload where embedding.length == 1536. Quick snippet from our ingest log:
```
POST /v1/embeddings model=acme/vec-compact:pin-2026-03
Response: 200 OK
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.001,0.224,...],"index":0}],"usage":{"tokens":12}}
// embedding array length = 1536
```

support_julie: Customer says this started right after we applied the pinned variant lock yesterday evening. They rolled back their client, but server output still different.

eng_oncall_tom: Can you paste the exact model id they pinned and the variant id? Also need the original embedding length they registered with (1024?) and a minimal repro curl.

support_julie: Model id: `vec-compact` variant pinned: `vec-compact@v2-locked-20260316` — customer schema says orig_dim=1024. Repro curl from their report:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \
  -d '{"model":"vec-compact@v2-locked-20260316","input":"hello world"}'
```

eng_runtime_lee: Quick thought: if the pinned variant resolved to a different checkpoint or quant/profile, that could change output width. But 1536 -> 1024 is a non-trivial architecture change. Could also be we accidentally substituted a different model family on fallback.

ml_lead_anya: I looked at onboarding logs for `vec-compact`. There was a canary deploy of `vec-compact-v3` yesterday with a new embedding head (1536). The pinning flow should have locked to the older v2 artifact; looks like a variant alias mapping drifted and resolved to v3. I'll check alias -> artifact mapping.

support_julie: Customer provided hashes: expected artifact sha256 `a1b2...v2`, current response indicates artifact `c3d4...v3`.

eng_oncall_tom: If alias drifted, we should: 1) roll the customer's alias back to v2, 2) invalidate caches that might point to v3, 3) run a dry-run of their ingestion on the v2 artifact to confirm 1024. Who can do the rollback?

infra_bob: I can force alias revert for that customer's namespace. Need approval from product for rollback window (it affects reserved capacity routing).

product_olivia: Approve emergency alias revert for AcmeInsights only. We need to communicate an expected 10-minute disruption. Coordinate with infra and eng-oncall.

deploybot: [deploybot] Revert request queued: target=vec-compact@acme/alias -> vec-compact@v2-artifact. Tracking: INF-5234.

eng_runtime_lee: After revert, please fetch metadata from our internal model-metadata endpoint to assert `embedding_dim` field:
```
GET /internal/models/vec-compact/meta
Response: {"artifact":"a1b2...","embedding_dim":1024}
```

ml_lead_anya: Also will add a guard in the pinning service so alias resolution explicitly checks artifact checksum at lock time. If mismatch, block the pin and notify.

support_julie: I'll tell the customer we plan a targeted revert and a follow-up verification. Can someone run a test post-revert and paste the curl + response so I can share?

eng_oncall_tom: Will run verification. Once infra reverts, I'll POST the same test input and paste the returned embedding length.

infra_bob: Revert executed at 2351112500. Pushed alias mapping and invalidated CDN/cache for model routing.

eng_oncall_tom: Post-revert verification: ran the curl against the pinned variant id. Response: embedding.length == 1024. Sample: `{"data":[{"embedding":[0.001,0.224,...],"index":0}],"meta":{"artifact":"a1b2...","embedding_dim":1024}}`

acme_bryan: Confirmed on Acme side after they re-run ingestion against pinned variant. Their ingestion succeeded and index health returned to normal. Thank you.

ml_lead_anya: Root cause: alias drift during canary promotion. Action items: 1) add checksum enforcement to pin/alias flows, 2) add an auto-detection alert when returned embedding_dim differs from model metadata, 3) add a short-run integration test that verifies embedding length on pin.

product_olivia: Please add a short customer-facing postmortem and share timeline + mitigations. Priority: P2 for platform change, P0 customer communication.

support_julie: Filed INF-5234 in tracker with notes and verified fix + customer ack. I'll send the postmortem draft to product for review. :white_check_mark:

eng_oncall_tom: Marking thread resolved; reopen if Acme reports new anomalies.

support_julie: Closing with customer "fix validated" and follow-ups scheduled.
